name: Photographer of Teyvat Desert Theme
description: 1=Olah! Hello, Travelers~ With the arrival of Version 3.1, the desert area of Sumeru has finally revealed itself to us. Clouds of sand, mysterious ruins, and the giant robot... All have been capturing the Travelers' attention. Then, in the vast desert beyond the forest, what wondrous scenery have you encountered? Come and share them with everyone else! Take part in the #Photographer of Teyvat: Part IV by sharing your photos taken in the Sumeru desert according to the designated themes for a chance to win Primogems!
